reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend helper with holidays and reuses recurConfigToRSchedule/RSchedule, but the daily-skip rule is not put in a shared helper and is re-coded in getNextDate and getDatesInRange.

duplication.why: The daily weekend/holiday skip predicate is written twice (getNextDate's skipDailyWeekends/isSkippedDay and getDatesInRange's isDaily branch), and getDatesInRange copies the RSchedule/occurrences/try-catch skeleton of getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: isHoliday and the moving loop sit in shared/schedules.ts where the weekend rule lives, but the daily-skip decision is embedded in each caller (getNextDate, the server handler) rather than in the shared weekend definition.

scope.why: Changes are limited to the schedule date logic, the new handler, type and parse plumbing plus tests; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: The weekend rule now has three diverging implementations: getNextDate and getDatesInRange skip daily weekends, getUpcomingDates and the two schedule-template callers neither skip daily occurrences nor pass holidays, so future rule changes must be hunted down.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange re-decides the daily skip with its own d.isWeekend||isHoliday check instead of a shared rule; server/budget/schedule-template.ts calls getDateWithSkippedWeekend without holidays or daily handling.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily skip predicate appears as isSkippedDay + dates.find in getNextDate and as a null-returning map branch in getDatesInRange: same rule reshaped rather than shared.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays parameter; getNextDate gains a daily special-case branch (skipDailyWeekends) bypassing the helper; getDatesInRange re-implements the daily skip; schedule-template.ts's two calls (and getUpcomingDates for daily) do not route through the updated rule.
